subject: Pricing followup: target $/1M tokens benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + target $/1M tokens benchmarking (next steps)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on pricing targets and a small benchmarking plan:  

- Key takeaways from the call: Acme plans to use the model for an L4 customer support assistant with ~2M messages/month and average prompt+completion ~500 tokens. Primary requirement: sub-200ms 95th percentile latency for short-support-turn use cases.
- Volume we discussed: 1.8M-2.5M messages/month; estimated 900M-1.2B tokens/month (based on your average token estimate).
- Budget range: you mentioned early-stage target of $4k-$12k/month for hosted inference during pilot (we flagged that would require an aggressive unit price).

Next steps I propose:  
1) I’ll send a short token-level benchmarking file that maps your volumes and target $/1M tokens vs typical pricing from OpenAI/Anthropic and common open-model hosts (GCP/Vertex, AWS Bedrock-like hosts).
2) If you want, we can run a quick 7-10 day targeted benchmark on a representative slice (5k requests/day) to show actual cost and latency delta — Redwood will cover the infra for that pilot.
3) Vanessa will follow up with a narrow commercial proposal (target price bands at 3 tiers: pilot, production small, production+).

Attached: acme_token_benchmark-20261018.xlsx (token math + target $/1M scenarios) and a short Redwood unit economics one-pager (redwood-pricing-1m-token-breakdown.pdf).

Can you confirm: the 500-token average is still accurate, and is the pilot budget window still around $4k-$12k/mo? If those numbers moved, share updated ranges and we’ll re-run the target price table.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_token_benchmark-20261018.xlsx (xlsx, 78KB stub)
Attachment: redwood-pricing-1m-token-breakdown.pdf (pdf, 32KB stub)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + target $/1M tokens benchmarking (next steps)

Thanks Neha — helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side:  

- The 500-token avg is a reasonable midpoint; we do see a long tail (support escalations up to 1.2k tokens) but overall 450-550 is the expected range.
- Pilot budget: we’d prefer to cap pilot spend around $8k/month (middle of the range). If Redwood can show unit economics that get us near ~$8k for the pilot volumes, that will be compelling.
- For the production projection, our director is expecting target <$2,500 per 1M tokens (ideal), but we realize that depends on latency/availability SLAs. So please include target price bands centered around $2,500 and up to $5,000 per 1M as the more conservative option.

We’re interested in the 7-10 day benchmark. Aisha will coordinate the test data slice (sanitized logs) and measure latency from our East coast users. Can Redwood cover the infra for the pilot and share a sample config?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of Product, Acme AI
---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha.p@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + target $/1M tokens benchmarking (next steps)

Jordan — great, thanks for the clarifications. Quick response and proposed benchmark plan below.

1) Target price bands: based on your pilot cap of $8k/mo and the estimated pilot token volume (approx 900M tokens/month), the implied target pilot price would need to be ~ $8,888 per 1M tokens to stay within budget at full volume — which is higher than your $2,500 ideal. However, pilots rarely run at full projected scale, so we included staged scenarios in the attachment that show:
   - Pilot (scaled slice): 10% of traffic for 30 days -> ~90M tokens. At $2,500/1M that would be ~$2250/month — well within $8k.
   - Production small (50% scale): 450M tokens -> at $2,500/1M = $1,125,000/month (obviously production economics require reserved capacity).

2) Benchmark vs common hosts (summary from the attached):
   - OpenAI: effectively ~ $X,XXX-$XX,XXX per 1M tokens depending on model (chat-optimized pricing).
   - Anthropic: similar band for chat-capable models; some discounts for committed usage.
   - Open-model hosts (self-hosted quantized on GPUs / managed hosts): can get to $500-$1,800 per 1M tokens depending on quantization and batching configs.

We’re attaching a short note that maps realistic pilot scenarios to a target $/1M that meets your $8k cap if you run a scaled slice for validation first. Redwood can absolutely spin the 7-10 day pilot on our side (we’ll provision a small dedicated pool and instrument latency from your East Coast region). We’ll need:
   - sanitized sample logs (Aisha to send)
   - preferred test window (Aisha / Jordan pls advise a 7-day contiguous window)
   - acceptance criteria: 95th <= 200ms and average completion costs within the pilot target band.

3) Commercial next steps: Vanessa will draft a short two-page pilot contract (scope + pilot cap + success criteria + option to convert to Reserved Dedicated pricing).

We’ll aim to have the benchmark config + test plan doc on your drive link by EOD today.

Best —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
